title: Automation Protocol for Plasmid DNA Extraction from E. coli
author: Nina Alperovich
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bjjvkkn6
materials: Use the filter press to push the lysate solutions through the filter plate into a new 96-well deep well plate (Eppendorf, 951033588) at 20 psi for 180 s followed by 65 psi for 30 s.
Transfer the cleared lysate solutions to a 96-well glass fiber binding plate (Nunc, 278010) and use the filter press to push the solutions through the binding plate at 40 psi for 60 s.

steps.title: Centrifuge cells and remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Pellet the cultures in a 96‑well deep‑well plate by centrifugation at 3878 g (4500 rpm) for 10 min at 23 °C, then discard the supernatant from each well.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 3878 g (4500 rpm) for 10 min at 23 °C.

steps.title: Resuspend cell pellets
steps.instruction: Resuspend each pellet in 200 µL Resuspension Buffer and mix 10 times by repeated aspiration and dispense.

steps.title: Transfer resuspended samples to shaker plate
steps.instruction: Move the resuspended cell samples to a new 96‑well plate (Abgene, AB‑1127) placed on an automated microplate shaker.

steps.title: Add Lysate Buffer and mix
steps.instruction: Add 250 µL Lysate Buffer to each well and mix by shaking the plate at 90 rpm for 2 min.

steps.title: Add Neutralization Buffer and mix
steps.instruction: Add 350 µL cold (4 °C) Neutralization Buffer (Qiagen, 19064) to each well and mix by shaking at 90 rpm for 2 min.

steps.title: Mix with wide bore tips and filter
steps.instruction: Using wide‑bore tips (3.2 mm tip diameter), gently mix the lysate by 3 repeated aspiration/dispense cycles, transfer the samples to a 96‑well filter plate (Agilent, 201702‑100), and let them settle for 2 min.

substeps.instruction: Mix lysate with wide‑bore tips (3.2 mm) for 3 aspiration/dispense cycles.
Allow lysate to settle for 2 min.

steps.title: Add Binding Buffer and press
steps.instruction: Add 900 µL Binding Buffer (Qiagen, 19066) to each well and use the filter press to push the buffer through the binding plate at 40 psi for 60 s.

steps.title: Add Wash Buffer and press
steps.instruction: Add 900 µL Wash Buffer to each well and use the filter press to push it through the binding plate at 40 psi for 60 s.

steps.title: Dry binding plate
steps.instruction: Dry the binding plate with the filter press by applying 65 psi for 7 min.

steps.title: Add heated nuclease‑free water
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL nuclease‑free water (Thermo Scientific, AM9938) warmed to 60 °C to each well and wait 5 min.

steps.title: Elute DNA into low‑binding plate
steps.instruction: Elute DNA from the binding plate into a 96‑well low‑binding elution plate (Eppendorf, 30603303) using the filter press at 65 psi for 7 min.
